coordinate_convention: Zero-based PNG pixels. Bounding boxes are [left,top,right,bottom], with right/bottom excluded. Approximate visual bounds include edge antialiasing unless specified. PNG pixels are not CSS pixels.
metadata_limits: All 39 are 8-bit-per-channel, noninterlaced RGBA PNGs. All parsed PNG chunk-type sets are IHDR/IDAT/deBG/IEND.
No pHYs chunk or authoritative DPR/CSS viewport metadata was found; dpi=null means absent, not 96 DPI. The private deBG chunk was not interpreted as CSS or device metadata.

Exact font family, font weight numbers, CSS font sizes, CSS border radii, CSS shadow offsets/blur/spread/opacity, responsive breakpoints and browser behavior cannot be established from these rasters alone.
Texture, gradients, antialiasing and resampling mean one sampled hex is not proof of a flat CSS fill. Colors below are observed image pixels; they are not guessed CSS tokens.
No app implementation was changed or run, and no implementation tests or pixel-perfect comparison were performed.

sampling_method.pixel_reader: Windows System.Drawing.Bitmap.GetPixel at original intrinsic resolution; no resize or image rewrite.
sampling_method.point_method: Exact RGBA center pixel plus 9x9 centered patch per-channel median/min/max. Border patches cross adjacent fills; their patch median is not a border estimate.
sampling_method.modal_method: Count exact RGBA triplets satisfying a filter inside the specified half-open ROI; select highest count, ties by lexicographic channel-string order; record first row-major coordinate.

filters.gold: R > 140 and R > G+15 and G > 70 and B < 145

sampling_method.alpha_note: All recorded sample pixels have A=255. This does not assert every source pixel is opaque.

normalization.status: Explicit proposed comparison convention only; not measured CSS dimensions.
normalization.formula: For chosen crop [L,T,R,B], s=390/(R-L); x_css=(x_png-L)*s; y_css=(y_png-T)*s; width_css=width_png*s; height_css=height_png*s.
normalization.scope: Use each representative crop independently; preserve aspect ratio. Do not normalize all 941-wide files with the same crop when their drawn app viewport differs.
uncertainties: DPR unknown; exported image may have been resized independently of any browser.
Inset frame/bezel and synthetic status artwork are not authoritative viewport or safe-area dimensions.
Edges have approximately 2?4 PNG px visual/antialias uncertainty as recorded; y status cutoffs are explicit editorial comparison choices.
Normalized dimensions are hypothetical CSS comparison units and must be checked against real implementation screenshots before any fidelity claim.
